{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for non-numeric revenue entries
non_numeric_revenue = sales_df[sales_df['revenue'].isna()]['revenue']

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

# Check how many completed orders have zero revenue
zero_revenue_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] == 0].shape[0]

# Verify that the mean is computed only on valid numeric values
valid_revenue_count = completed_orders['revenue'].notna().sum()

non_numeric_revenue, mean_revenue_completed, zero_revenue_completed, valid_revenue_count"}
